title: 3-step onboarding, settings dedupe, focus toggle in study views

acceptance.text: 1) OnboardingFlow trimmed to 3 focused BJT/work steps (goal -> level with optional 5-Q diagnostic -> daily minutes finishing into /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review), removing topics/style steps and off-focus travel/general goals while preserving POST /api/recommendation/onboarding/preferences contract with safe defaults (topics:[], style:'mixed'), localized across vi/en/ja, and legacy /[locale]/onboarding redirects to /{locale} (Strategy a: onboarding-client.tsx & onboarding-diagnostic.tsx kept on disk). 2) Account settings deduplicated: /[locale]/settings/accounts renders real learner identity plus linked social accounts, /[locale]/settings/linked-accounts redirects to /{locale}/settings/accounts (Strategy a: linked-accounts/_components/accounts-settings-client.tsx kept on disk), and MeTabSettings removes the duplicate 7th linkedAccounts card so /me has no duplicate account surface. 3) Minimal localStorage-backed study focus mode hook (default OFF) + localized Tập trung/Focus/集中 toggle mounted in the study-session headers of ReviewSession (flashcards), ScenarioPlayClient (scenarios), and QuizClient (quiz); when ON, hides non-essential ambient UI in each view while keeping core study content and controls intact. Policy §5 contract-change justification: scenario-play-client.contract.test.tsx previously indexed choice buttons via querySelectorAll('button')[0..1] because no header button existed; adding the required focus toggle button to the scenario session header changes button DOM index order, so choice lookups are scoped to choice buttons ([data-choice-key]) while preserving 100% of existing API, error, and WCAG-AA contrast assertions unchanged.
